title: ConfigError wraps String, not structured fields
description: smtp/config.rs and reader/config.rs ConfigError::Io(String) and ConfigError::Parse(String) stringify the original error at the point of wrapping, discarding type information. Library callers (stoa-smtp is a lib crate) cannot inspect std::io::ErrorKind from Io or line/column position from Parse. Idiomatic Rust would wrap the original error type: Io(std::io::Error), Parse(Box<toml::de::Error>), using thiserror #[from] for automatic conversion. The Validation variant holding String is acceptable since those messages are constructed locally.
